text:
sara: FYI our nightly SAST (job `sast-full-scan`) spiked with 120 new findings on repo `platform/api` after the 03:00 deploy. Link: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/sast-full/342
josh: saw that. Most are path-traversal and weird sanitizer warnings in generated code. Repro locally?
priya: I tried a local run and it's clean. The CI logs show scanner couldn't fetch submodule `shared/crypto` and fell back to the vendored snapshot. snippet:
infra-bot: [gha] checkout submodule shared/crypto -> failed (403)
infra-bot: [kms] decrypt repo-key -> AccessDenied (serviceAccount:sast-runner@ci)
ev an: KMS rotation happened last night (1778650000). Rotation playbook claims ephemeral grant to `sast-runner@ci` but audit shows the grant wasn't applied to the repo-access role. event id: evt-kms-9921
sara: so scanner ran against partial code (vendored snapshot) which produced noise. This explains the mass findings. Marking as probable FP until we can re-run.
josh: can we get an audit log export that ties the decrypt failure to the scan id? run: `gh api /repos/redwood/platform/scan-artefacts/342 -H "Accept: application/json"` -> returns `error: decrypt failed (KMS:AccessDenied)`, attach to ticket.
priya: opening triage proposal: 1) suppress the SAST alerts with evidence (KMS AccessDenied + submodule checkout error), 2) infra to issue ephemeral KMS decrypt grant for `sast-runner@ci` for 10m, 3) re-run `sast-full-scan` and verify findings reduce, 4) update rotation docs to include `repo-access` binding and post-rotation smoke-check for submodule checkout.
security-bot: [action] open ticket SEC-SAST-17876: investigate SAST noise after KMS rotation; add logs and auditor link
josh: for suppression add this console output: `checkout shared/crypto -> 403` and `kms: AccessDenied` + audit event evt-kms-9921. Also include current vulnerability spike count.
ev an: infra oncall here. I can grant temporary decrypt for `sast-runner@ci` for 15m. Doing it now and will post bind id.
infra-bot: ephemeral grant created -> grant-id g-327a; TTL 15m; applied to serviceAccount:sast-runner@ci for kms:decrypt
sara: queued re-run. I'll paste results in ~7m.
security-bot: [gha] sast-full-scan re-run 1787654321 -> build 1787654322 queued by sara
sara: re-run finished: findings down from 120 -> 6 (mostly true positives). Closing noise as false positives and leaving the 6 for normal triage. Updating SEC-SAST-17876 with before/after diffs and attach `g-327a` grant id + audit export.
priya: follow-up PR planned: add `ci-scan-smoke` step to rotation playbook that does `git submodule update --init` + `kms:decrypt` check, fail rotation if smoke fails. I'll include a unit test for service account binding in infra repo.
josh: also recommend adding an automated suppression rule for known post-rotation noise that references KMS decrypt errors, so triage can be faster.
ev an: noted; I'll add a backend metric alert if more than 20 SAST findings spike immediately after a keystore rotation window.
sara: thanks everyone. Moving ticket to awaiting-PR. :white_check_mark:
